# DRP9 Tech

> DRP9 Tech builds mobile apps, web platforms, marketplaces and AI agents, and runs dedicated product teams. It is part of an ecosystem of sister companies in the UAE, Portugal and the Netherlands (Rise Personal, Bnsights, Kangaroo Parade, KZ Advisory) that share owners, partners, teams and projects. Founders: Mohamed El Sawaf (CEO), Khaled Gomaa (Chief Technology and Product Officer), Kareem Zaher (Chief AI Officer). Works from Cairo, Amsterdam, Lisbon and Dubai. More than 50 developers and account managers work with DRP9 Tech across the world, with experience in many industries. The team has built government portals, apps and web apps in Saudi Arabia and the UAE for more than ten years; that work is confidential.
